channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-127231 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | A double free in the X.509 name constraints enforcement of GnuTLS 3.8.13 on all platforms allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service (application crash) via a certificate chain containing a NameConstraints extension processed while the application is under memory pressure. When an already populated name constraints object is reinitialized, previously freed list pointers are not cleared, so a memory allocation failure precisely at reinitialization leaves a dangling pointer that is freed again during a later cleanup.

item.title: CVE-2026-132281 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This affects the function SqlUtils.batchExecute of the file /api/database/upload of the component Database Maintenance Module. The manipulation results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

item.title: CVE-2026-132282 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was determined in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This vulnerability affects the function FileUtil.upload of the file /api/localStorage of the component File Upload Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

item.title: CVE-2026-132283 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | A vulnerability was identified in Directus up to 12.7.0. This issue affects the function AuthenticationService.refresh of the file api/src/services/authentication.ts of the component Authentication Service. Such manipulation leads to session expiration. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2026-132745 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrative users to inject SQL through the k (does not contain) comparator in list view search_params. Attackers can send crafted search_params to the ListAjax getRecordsCount mode, breaking out of the unescaped NOT LIKE clause to extract database contents via boolean or time-based techniques.

item.title: CVE-2026-132746 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via unescaped clientid values in the wsapp_map webservice operation. Attackers can register a sync application with wsapp_register, then send delete-mode entries with quoted clientid values processed by SyncServer.php to extract database contents including administrator access keys.

item.title: CVE-2026-132747 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with export access to inject SQL through unvalidated selected_ids values in ExportData.php. Attackers can send a UNION SELECT payload in selected_ids[] to the ExportSelectedRecords mode and read password hashes and access keys from the exported CSV.

item.title: CVE-2026-132748 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a PHP code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject code via the updatedFields parameter into config.inc.php. Attackers can supply a crafted HELPDESK_SUPPORT_EMAIL_ID value that passes email validation but closes the PHP string literal to execute arbitrary operating system commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-132749 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Vtiger CRM through 8.4.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in ReportRun::generateAdvFilterSql() that allows authenticated low-privileged users to inject SQL via the bw comparator. Attackers can send a crafted advanced_filter parameter containing a single quote to the Reports getRecordsCount action to break out of BETWEEN literals and extract database contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-132750 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Meilisearch before 1.55.1 and 1.56.x before 1.56.1 contains a quadratic memory consumption vulnerability in filter-parser that allows attackers with a search API key to exhaust server memory. Attackers can send a roughly 100 KB filter, such as a _geoPolygon with thousands of coordinates, to the search endpoint, crashing the server and taking all indexes offline.

item.title: CVE-2026-132751 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | yt through 4.4.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute Python code by supplying a crafted con_args attribute in a ytdata HDF5 file. SavedDataset._parse_parameter_file() passes con_args to eval() unrestricted, so loading a malicious .h5 file with yt.load() runs attacker code as the user.

item.title: CVE-2026-132752 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | ScreenTinker before 3.2.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the GET /api/kiosk/:id/render endpoint that allows users with kiosk page edit rights to store javascript: URLs in page buttons. Attackers can trigger script execution in the dashboard origin when an administrator activates the button, hijacking the victim's session and taking full control of the instance.

item.title: CVE-2026-132753 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | MP4v2 through 2.1.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in MP4RtpHintTrack::GetPayload() in src/rtphint.cpp that passes an unchecked rtpmap value to strchr(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file whose RTP hint track has a corrupted hinf atom to crash mp4info or applications calling MP4GetHintTrackRtpPayload().

item.title: CVE-2026-132754 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc that allows attackers to trigger a global buffer over-read via oversized iloc field sizes. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with invalid offset_size or length_size values to overrun the BitStream_Fast mask table and crash applications analysing the file.

item.title: CVE-2026-132755 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in tfsxml_leave() caused by an off-by-one error when handling generic <! markup in truncated XML. Attackers can supply a crafted media file with malformed ADM XML parsed by File_Adm.cpp to crash MediaInfo or applications using MediaInfoLib.

item.title: CVE-2026-132756 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Geany through 2.1.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to run shell commands by embedding metacharacters in filenames substituted into build and execute commands. Attackers can craft a file named with backticks or $(...) that executes via /bin/sh when a user runs Compile, Build or Execute, gaining code execution as the user.

item.title: CVE-2026-132757 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in DoWriteMeta() in src/isomedia/isom_store.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an ISOBMFF file with a meta box containing an iloc entry but no dref box, crashing MP4Box during rewrite operations like -unhint.

item.title: CVE-2026-132758 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to crash the application through an unmatched closing ProtoDeclare element. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file with a mismatched closing ProtoDeclare or ExternProtoDeclare element, causing a dereference of a NULL parsing_proto pointer and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132759 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because gf_node_free() frees nodes without detaching routes that still reference them via FromNode. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTO graphs so gf_sg_route_del() accesses freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-132760 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132761 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by supplying crafted XMT scene files. Commands created inside a PROTO scope keep a raw pointer to a freed prototype sub-scene graph, which is read during teardown, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132762 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a divide by zero vulnerability in DumpTrackInfo() in applications/mp4box/filedump.c that fails to check the media timescale for zero. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a zero media timescale to make MP4Box -infon raise SIGFPE and crash, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132763 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() that allows attackers to write a zero byte outside the heap line buffer via crafted XML attribute values. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a ROUTE or command referencing an undefined node, imported with MP4Box, to crash the process and corrupt memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-132764 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves ROUTE commands of a discarded node queued after being freed by gf_sg_command_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file imported with MP4Box so xmt_resolve_routes() writes to freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-132765 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy because Conditional node commands keep raw pointers to target nodes freed by gf_sg_reset(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene processed with -info or -add to trigger heap use-after-free, crashing the process and corrupting heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-132766 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in MP4Box because gf_sg_reset frees DEF'd proto sub-graph nodes without removing them from the GF_Proto node_code list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTOs so gf_sg_proto_del unregisters freed nodes during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-132767 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via unchecked field lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose atIndexField names a non-existent node field, causing a NULL read during import and denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132768 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c that leaves freed forward-referenced nodes cached in parser->peeked_nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a node targeted by an SFCommandBuffer command, triggering a later DEF lookup on the freed node and crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-132769 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_script_field() that allows attackers to trigger a heap out-of-bounds read via duplicate Script field names with conflicting types. Attackers can craft an XMT file that, when imported with MP4Box, causes gf_sg_vrml_mf_reset() to treat a single-value field as multi-value, crashing the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-132770 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_proto() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process via a redefined ProtoDeclare name. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a duplicate ProtoDeclare name, causing gf_sg_proto_new() to return NULL and crashing MP4Box during import.

item.title: CVE-2026-132771 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in ReplaceDEFNode that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by triggering access to a partly freed child list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose InputSensor command buffer cascades prototype sub-graph deletion during gf_sg_vrml_parent_destroy, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-132772 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT parser that leaves parser->command_buffer pointing into a freed InputSensor node. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file triggering a parse error so xmt_node_start() writes NULL into freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing MP4Box.

item.title: CVE-2026-132773 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Attendize through 2.8.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in EventOrdersController::postCancelOrder() that allows authenticated organisers to cancel attendees belonging to other accounts' events. Attackers can cancel one of their own orders while supplying foreign attendee IDs, which Attendee::findFromSelection() loads unfiltered, invalidating tickets for any event on the installation.

item.title: CVE-2026-132774 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Attendize through 2.8.0 contains a cross-account authorization bypass vulnerability in EventAttendeesController::postMessageAttendees() that allows authenticated organisers to message other accounts' attendees by supplying a foreign event_id. Attackers, including self-registered organisers, can post to the attendees message endpoint for another event to send arbitrary emails to all attendees, enabling phishing and impersonation.

item.title: CVE-2026-132775 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by attaching nodes from unrelated proto sub-graphs to field-replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene buffering such a command in a Conditional node, causing gf_node_try_destroy() to access the freed node, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-132776 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying crafted XMT files. Attackers can assign a second node to an SFNode command field so xmt_node_end() frees a forward-referenced child still cached in peeked_nodes, triggering a crash during DEF lookup in xmt_find_node().

item.title: CVE-2026-132777 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in Conditional_execute() because SetupConditional() stores a BIFS decoder pointer that gf_sm_load_run_isom() later frees without clearing. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a BIFS Conditional node processed with -nstatx to crash MP4Box and potentially corrupt the heap.

item.title: CVE-2026-132778 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_field_is_sftime_offset() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an MP4 file whose BIFS scene contains cyclic PROTO IS relations, causing unbounded recursion that exhausts the stack and causes denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-91138 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description:
Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | The Deco BE65 v3 firmware contains a shared hard-coded password hash for the root account in /etc/shadow. Where the corresponding credential is accepted by a production authentication path, an attacker with existing unprivileged shell access may recover or otherwise obtain the plaintext password and use it to escalate privileges.
Successful exploitation may grant root-level access to the affected device.

item.title: CVE-2026-91139 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.1
item.description:
Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.1 | Deco BE65 firmware contains a cryptographic weakness in the local web-management authentication flow due to the use of insufficient RSA key sizes. The /login?form=auth endpoint returns a 512-bit RSA public key and sequence value.
Successful exploitation may compromise the cryptographic protections applied to local web-management authentication traffic.
